description: Poll an OpenAI Batch API submission's live status (never trusting stale cached metadata); fire a Dagster run against the paired openai_batch_results asset once the batch reaches a terminal state. Cursor-deduped so downstream fires once per completion.

watch_asset_key.label: Watch Asset Key
watch_asset_key.description: The openai_batch_submit asset to watch for a batch_id in its materialization metadata.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Job to trigger once the watched batch reaches a terminal state.

results_asset_key.label: Results Asset Key
results_asset_key.description: Asset key of the openai_batch_results asset this sensor's RunRequest targets. Used only to derive the correct op name (via AssetKey.to_python_identifier()) for run_config -- not to look up anything at sensor-eval time.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the OpenAI API key.
